limits: Native groups were recorded in requirement order against each then-current implementation. Earlier CHANGE-05/07 evidence does not claim fields added by CHANGE-09 or the later CHANGE-04 processed count. Final combined source is covered by final CI and clean audit.
No new native IME evidence; UIA sometimes exposes only RootWebArea. Detailed keyboard focus and late-response behavior come from actual Electron automatic tests.

Controlled host external writes and SQLite/IO faults are not SDK-generated modifications or synthetic observations. Pure protocol and injected lifecycle cases remain separately identified in automated tests.
Not an OS filesystem sandbox, no ACL/permission/empty-directory/excluded-content/external-side-effect restoration, no hunk rollback or snapshot-retention delivery.
